id: \bOak: Ah \PN, how is it going? Is your Pikachu doing well?
en: \bOak: Ah \PN, how is it going? Is your Pikachu doing well?
it: \bOak: Ah, \PN, come va? Il tuo Pikachu sta bene?

id: \bOak: If you want it, take it.
en: \bOak: If you want it, take it.
it: \bOak: Se lo vuoi, prendilo.

id: \bOak: Ah \PN, you got the GS ball didn't you?
en: \bOak: Ah \PN, you got the GS ball didn't you?
it: \bOak: Ah, \PN, hai preso la GS Ball, vero?

id: \bGood good. Let me have a look at it.
en: \bGood good. Let me have a look at it.
it: \bBene, bene. Fammela vedere.

id: \bHmm. I can't seem to figure out what to do with it.
en: \bHmm. I can't seem to figure out what to do with it.
it: \bMmm. Non riesco proprio a capire cosa farne.

id: \b\PN, can I ask you to hold on to it a little longer and take it to Kurt?
en: \b\PN, can I ask you to hold on to it a little longer and take it to Kurt?
it: \b\PN, posso chiederti di tenerla ancora un po' e di portarla a Kurt?

id: \bHe lives in Azalea Town in the Johto region. The fastest way there should be on Route 22. It's near the Kanto League.
en: \bHe lives in Azalea Town in the Johto region. The fastest way there should be on Route 22. It's near the Kanto League.
it: \bVive ad Azalina, nella regione di Johto. La strada più veloce dovrebbe essere il Percorso 22. È vicino alla Lega di Kanto.

id: \bOak: The fastest way to the Johto region is through Route 22. It's near the Kanto League.
en: \bOak: The fastest way to the Johto region is through Route 22. It's near the Kanto League.
it: \bOak: La strada più veloce per la regione di Johto passa per il Percorso 22. È vicino alla Lega di Kanto.

id: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. I heard you did well in the Silver Conference.
en: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. I heard you did well in the Silver Conference.
it: \bOak: Ah, ciao \PN. Ho sentito che te la sei cavata bene alla Conferenza Argento.

id: \bGary decided to head off to Hoenn to do some research. It seems like a lovely place for you to go if you want a new challenge.
en: \bGary decided to head off to Hoenn to do some research. It seems like a lovely place for you to go if you want a new challenge.
it: \bGary ha deciso di partire per Hoenn per fare delle ricerche. Sembra un posto incantevole per te, se cerchi una nuova sfida.

id: \bHead to Vermilion City. I'll tell the captain you are coming. There is a ship that will take you there.
en: \bHead to Vermilion City. I'll tell the captain you are coming. There is a ship that will take you there.
it: \bVai ad Aranciopoli. Avviserò il capitano del tuo arrivo. C'è una nave che ti porterà lì.

id: \bAlso, speak to my aide downstairs. He has a gift for you.
en: \bAlso, speak to my aide downstairs. He has a gift for you.
it: \bE parla anche con il mio assistente al piano di sotto. Ha un regalo per te.

id: \bAnd last but not least, your mother has some new clothes for you. Here you go.
en: \bAnd last but not least, your mother has some new clothes for you. Here you go.
it: \bE infine, ma non meno importante, tua madre ha dei vestiti nuovi per te. Ecco qui.

id: \bThey look spendid. If you'd prefer your old ones though you can change with the dresser in your room.
en: \bThey look spendid. If you'd prefer your old ones though you can change with the dresser in your room.
it: \bSono splendidi. Se però preferisci quelli vecchi, puoi cambiarti con l'armadio in camera tua.

id: \bOak: Head to Vermilion City. I'll tell the captain you are coming. There is a ship that will take you to Hoenn.
en: \bOak: Head to Vermilion City. I'll tell the captain you are coming. There is a ship that will take you to Hoenn.
it: \bOak: Vai ad Aranciopoli. Avviserò il capitano del tuo arrivo. C'è una nave che ti porterà a Hoenn.

id: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. I heard you did well in the Ever Grande Conference.
en: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. I heard you did well in the Ever Grande Conference.
it: \bOak: Ah, ciao \PN. Ho sentito che te la sei cavata bene alla Conferenza Iridopoli.

id: \bIt's good timing too since the Battle Frontier just opened up right here in Kanto! The first one I would recommend is the Battle Factory near Cerulean City.
en: \bIt's good timing too since the Battle Frontier just opened up right here in Kanto! The first one I would recommend is the Battle Factory near Cerulean City.
it: \bE arrivi proprio al momento giusto, perché il Parco Lotta ha appena aperto qui a Kanto! Il primo che ti consiglio è la Fabbrica Lotta vicino a Celestopoli.

id: \bOak: Head to Cerulean City to battle the Battle Frontier.
en: \bOak: Head to Cerulean City to battle the Battle Frontier.
it: \bOak: Vai a Celestopoli per affrontare il Parco Lotta.

id: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. So you beat the Battle Frontier then?
en: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. So you beat the Battle Frontier then?
it: \bOak: Ah, ciao \PN. Allora hai battuto il Parco Lotta?

id: \bYou're thinking about the Sinnoh region? I'll set up a ride for you. Like always, head over to Vermilion City.
en: \bYou're thinking about the Sinnoh region? I'll set up a ride for you. Like always, head over to Vermilion City.
it: \bStai pensando alla regione di Sinnoh? Ti organizzo io il viaggio. Come sempre, vai ad Aranciopoli.

id: \bAnd once again, here are some new clothes.
en: \bAnd once again, here are some new clothes.
it: \bE ancora una volta, ecco dei vestiti nuovi.

id: \bOak: Head to Vermilion City to get a ride to Sinnoh.
en: \bOak: Head to Vermilion City to get a ride to Sinnoh.
it: \bOak: Vai ad Aranciopoli per un passaggio verso Sinnoh.

id: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. So you finished the Sinnoh League.
en: \bOak: Ah, hello \PN. So you finished the Sinnoh League.
it: \bOak: Ah, ciao \PN. Quindi hai concluso la Lega di Sinnoh.

id: \bI saw you did quite well. I'm sure you're ready for your next challenge. Why not head to Unova with me?
en: \bI saw you did quite well. I'm sure you're ready for your next challenge. Why not head to Unova with me?
it: \bHo visto che te la sei cavata piuttosto bene. Sono sicuro che sei pronto per la prossima sfida. Perché non vieni a Unima con me?

id: \bHead over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take us over.
en: \bHead over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take us over.
it: \bVai a Smeraldopoli. Lì ci sarà un dirigibile che ci porterà a destinazione.

id: \bAnd as I'm sure you guessed by now your mother has a new outfit for you.
en: \bAnd as I'm sure you guessed by now your mother has a new outfit for you.
it: \bE come avrai già immaginato, tua madre ha un nuovo completo per te.

id: \bOak: Head over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take us over.
en: \bOak: Head over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take us over.
it: \bOak: Vai a Smeraldopoli. Lì ci sarà un dirigibile che ci porterà a destinazione.

id: \bOak: The Unova League sounds like a good challenge for you. I look forward to hearing your results.
en: \bOak: The Unova League sounds like a good challenge for you. I look forward to hearing your results.
it: \bOak: La Lega di Unima mi sembra una bella sfida per te. Non vedo l'ora di sapere come andrà.

id: This ball contains a Pokémon caught by the Professor.
en: This ball contains a Pokémon caught by the Professor.
it: Questa Poké Ball contiene un Pokémon catturato dal Professore.

id: \bOak: So, you want Pikachu, the Electric mouse Pokémon?
en: \bOak: So, you want Pikachu, the Electric mouse Pokémon?
it: \bOak: Allora, vuoi Pikachu, il Pokémon Topo di tipo Elettro?

id: \bOak: Unfortunately, it is the only one left, so I suggest you take it.
en: \bOak: Unfortunately, it is the only one left, so I suggest you take it.
it: \bOak: Purtroppo è l'unico rimasto, quindi ti consiglio di prenderlo.

en: \bPikachu
it: \bPikachu

id: \PN received a Pokédex!
en: \PN received a Pokédex!
it: \PN ha ricevuto un Pokédex!

id: You already have a Pokédex.
en: You already have a Pokédex.
it: Hai già un Pokédex.

id: \bHello \PN. I've managed to make a machine that captures the essence of powerful Trainers from a different dimension.
en: \bHello \PN. I've managed to make a machine that captures the essence of powerful Trainers from a different dimension.
it: \bCiao \PN. Sono riuscito a costruire una macchina che cattura l'essenza di Allenatori potenti provenienti da un'altra dimensione.

id: \bThey are called 'Pokédex holders'. Feel free to try the machine out.
en: \bThey are called 'Pokédex holders'. Feel free to try the machine out.
it: \bVengono chiamati "Possessori di Pokédex". Prova pure la macchina.

id: Rotom!!
en: Rotom!!
it: Rotom!!

id: \bOak: \PN, you're late. All of the starter Pokémon have been taken. ...Well there is one left, but it is a bit reckless.
en: \bOak: \PN, you're late. All of the starter Pokémon have been taken. ...Well there is one left, but it is a bit reckless.
it: \bOak: \PN, sei in ritardo. Hanno già preso tutti i Pokémon iniziali. ...Beh, ne è rimasto uno, ma è un po' scalmanato.

id: \bOak: It seems Pikachu doesn't like to stay in its Poké Ball.
en: \bOak: It seems Pikachu doesn't like to stay in its Poké Ball.
it: \bOak: Sembra che a Pikachu non piaccia stare nella sua Poké Ball.

id: \bOak: Charmander, an excellent choice!
en: \bOak: Charmander, an excellent choice!
it: \bOak: Charmander, un'ottima scelta!

id: \bOak: Squirtle, an excellent choice!
en: \bOak: Squirtle, an excellent choice!
it: \bOak: Squirtle, un'ottima scelta!

id: \bDon't forget to take your Pokédex before you leave.
en: \bDon't forget to take your Pokédex before you leave.
it: \bNon dimenticare di prendere il tuo Pokédex prima di andare.

id: \bOak: I hear you've beaten the Unova region as well. Wonderful work, \PN.
en: \bOak: I hear you've beaten the Unova region as well.  Wonderful work, \PN.
it: \bOak: Ho sentito che hai conquistato anche la regione di Unima.  Ottimo lavoro, \PN.

id: \bHave you met Rotom yet? I caught it in the Decolore Islands.
en: \bHave you met Rotom yet? I caught it in the Decolore Islands.
it: \bHai già conosciuto Rotom? L'ho catturato nelle Isole Decolore.

id: \bWhere's that at? Oh, it's a horrible place. I wouldn't want to make you suffer the trip. I only went to find a Rotom.
en: \bWhere's that at? Oh, it's a horrible place. I wouldn't want to make you suffer the trip. I only went to find a Rotom.
it: \bDove si trovano? Oh, è un posto orribile. Non vorrei farti soffrire un viaggio simile. Ci sono andato solo per trovare un Rotom.

id: \bYou plan on going to the Kalos region next? Excellent idea. I heard of a mysterious power coming from the region.
en: \bYou plan on going to the Kalos region next?  Excellent idea. I heard of a mysterious power coming from the region.
it: \bHai intenzione di andare nella regione di Kalos?  Ottima idea. Ho sentito parlare di un potere misterioso che proviene da quella regione.

id: \bHead over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take you over.
en: \bHead over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take you over.
it: \bVai a Smeraldopoli. Lì ci sarà un dirigibile che ti porterà a destinazione.

id: \bOh, and let's not forget your new clothes.
en: \bOh, and let's not forget your new clothes.
it: \bOh, e non dimentichiamo i tuoi vestiti nuovi.

id: \bOak: Head over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take you over.
en: \bOak: Head over to Viridian City. A blimp will be there to take you over.
it: \bOak: Vai a Smeraldopoli. Lì ci sarà un dirigibile che ti porterà a destinazione.

id: \bOak: I hear you were the runner up of Kalos League. Wonderful work.
en: \bOak: I hear you were the runner up of Kalos League. Wonderful work.
it: \bOak: Ho sentito che sei arrivato secondo alla Lega di Kalos. Ottimo lavoro.

id: \bIt's also wonderful timing. Your mother just won a trip to the Alola region.
en: \bIt's also wonderful timing. Your mother just won a trip to the Alola region.
it: \bE anche il tempismo è perfetto. Tua madre ha appena vinto un viaggio nella regione di Alola.

id: \bI also have this egg that I need to deliver to my cousin Samson. Give it to him when you arrive.
en: \bI also have this egg that I need to deliver to my cousin Samson. Give it to him when you arrive.
it: \bHo anche quest'uovo da consegnare a mio cugino Samson. Daglielo quando arrivi.

id: \bWait. Don't forget your clothes.
en: \bWait. Don't forget your clothes.
it: \bAspetta. Non dimenticare i tuoi vestiti.

id: \bOak: Go speak with your mother.
en: \bOak: Go speak with your mother.
it: \bOak: Va' a parlare con tua madre.

id: \bOak: Shouldn't you be in school right now?
en: \bOak: Shouldn't you be in school right now?
it: \bOak: Non dovresti essere a scuola adesso?

id: \bOak: Excellent work on becoming the Champion of Alola, \PN. It was quite the exciting match.
en: \bOak: Excellent work on becoming the Champion of Alola, \PN. It was quite the exciting match.
it: \bOak: Splendido lavoro, sei diventato Campione di Alola, \PN. È stato un incontro davvero emozionante.

id: \bI'm sorry to cut this meeting short, but a new Professor is opening a lab in Vermilion City and I agreed to attend.
en: \bI'm sorry to cut this meeting short, but a new Professor is opening a lab in Vermilion City and I agreed to attend.
it: \bMi dispiace interrompere così in fretta, ma un nuovo Professore apre un laboratorio ad Aranciopoli e ho promesso di partecipare.

id: \bI know! Why don't you join me? Well then, it's settled. Your mother and I will meet you in Vermilion.
en: \bI know! Why don't you join me? Well then, it's settled. Your mother and I will meet you in Vermilion.
it: \bHo un'idea! Perché non vieni con me? Bene allora, è deciso. Tua madre e io ti aspetteremo ad Aranciopoli.

id: \bNaturally, your mother left you some clothes here. She was worried you'd be in such a rush to see your Pokémon that you'd forget to stop home.
en: \bNaturally, your mother left you some clothes here.  She was worried you'd be in such a rush to see your Pokémon that you'd forget to stop home.
it: \bOvviamente, tua madre ti ha lasciato dei vestiti qui.  Temeva che saresti stato così di fretta di vedere i tuoi Pokémon da dimenticarti di passare a casa.

id: \bOak: Your mother and I will meet you in Vermilion.
en: \bOak: Your mother and I will meet you in Vermilion.
it: \bOak: Tua madre e io ti aspetteremo ad Aranciopoli.

id: \bOak: Hello \PN. How is it working with Professor Cerise?
en: \bOak: Hello \PN. How is it working with Professor Cerise?
it: \bOak: Ciao \PN. Come va il lavoro con il Professor Cerise?

id: \bOak: Hello \PN. How is it working with Professor Cerise? Is Project Mew going well for Goh?
en: \bOak: Hello \PN. How is it working with Professor Cerise? Is Project Mew going well for Goh?
it: \bOak: Ciao \PN. Come va il lavoro con il Professor Cerise? Il Progetto Mew procede bene per Goh?

id: \bOak: Hello \PN. The surprise I have for you is out back.
en: \bOak: Hello \PN. The surprise I have for you is out back.
it: \bOak: Ciao \PN. La sorpresa che ho per te è sul retro.

id: \bOak: Hello \PN. How did your meeting go with Paul? Did he mention he recieved an offer to become a Gym Leader?
en: \bOak: Hello \PN. How did your meeting go with Paul?  Did he mention he recieved an offer to become a Gym Leader?
it: \bOak: Ciao \PN. Com'è andato l'incontro con Paul?  Ti ha detto di aver ricevuto un'offerta per diventare Capopalestra?

id: \bOak: Excellent job on becoming the Monarch, \PN.
en: \bOak: Excellent job on becoming the Monarch, \PN.
it: \bOak: Ottimo lavoro, sei diventato il Monarca, \PN.

id: \bOak: Come back after another journey, have you? It's always a pleasant surprise.
en: \bOak: Come back after another journey, have you?  It's always a pleasant surprise.
it: \bOak: Sei tornato dopo un altro viaggio, eh?  È sempre una piacevole sorpresa.

id: \bYou've accomplished so much since you first met Pikachu. The bonds you've made, the regions you've explored, and the friends and Pokémon too.
en: \bYou've accomplished so much since you first met Pikachu. The bonds you've made, the regions you've explored, and the friends and Pokémon too.
it: \bHai ottenuto così tanto da quando hai conosciuto Pikachu. I legami che hai stretto, le regioni che hai esplorato, e anche gli amici e i Pokémon.

id: \bYou've never stopped growing as a Trainer, and I doubt you have any intention on quitting now. The road to becoming a Pokémon Master is a long one.
en: \bYou've never stopped growing as a Trainer, and I doubt you have any intention on quitting now. The road to becoming a Pokémon Master is a long one.
it: \bNon hai mai smesso di crescere come Allenatore, e dubito che tu abbia intenzione di fermarti adesso. La strada per diventare un Maestro di Pokémon è lunga.

id: \bI'm truly proud of you, \PN. I wish you luck in your next journey. And know that you're always welcomed back home.
en: \bI'm truly proud of you, \PN. I wish you luck in your next journey. And know that you're always welcomed back home.
it: \bSono davvero fiero di te, \PN. Ti auguro buona fortuna per il tuo prossimo viaggio. E sappi che sarai sempre il benvenuto a casa.

id: \bOak: I'm not sure what else there is for you to do, \PN. I would say you've made huge strides to becoming a Pokémon Master.
en: \bOak: I'm not sure what else there is for you to do, \PN. I would say you've made huge strides to becoming a Pokémon Master.
it: \bOak: Non so cos'altro ti resti da fare, \PN. Direi che hai fatto passi da gigante per diventare un Maestro di Pokémon.

id: \bYou could seek out the friends you've met along the way. They may want to see you again. I have a list of the places where they are somewhere around here.
en: \bYou could seek out the friends you've met along the way. They may want to see you again. I have a list of the places where they are somewhere around here.
it: \bPotresti andare a cercare gli amici che hai incontrato lungo la strada. Forse vorranno rivederti. Ho una lista dei posti dove si trovano, qui da qualche parte.
